name: Dendrite arborization and postsynaptic actin structural remodeling
rationale: All members concern dendrite branching and actin-based postsynaptic/spine structure; dendrite arborization and postsynaptic density maintenance distinguish it from the filopodium/RHOF and synaptic plasticity/translation confusables.

name: NGF-TRKA and p75NTR survival and death signaling
rationale: Members are NGF/TRKA cascades plus p75NTR and dependence-receptor death signalling, which the NTRK2/NTRK3-centred confusables lack.

qualifier: carbon dioxide hydration and pH control
name: Bicarbonate transport and CO2 hydration in pH control
rationale: All members concern bicarbonate transport (incl. SLC4 defects in renal tubular acidosis) and CO2 hydration/pH, distinguishing it from proton-pump acidification and phosphate/SLC26 anion confusables.

name: ESCRT-mediated viral budding and multivesicular body formation
rationale: Members share ESCRT-driven outward membrane fission in viral (HIV Gag) budding, MVB and exosome formation, unlike confusables focused on ESCRT in cytokinesis/nuclear envelope sealing or receptor endocytic downregulation.

name: CCT/TriC de novo folding and protein stabilization
rationale: Members centre on chaperonin CCT/TriC folding of nascent actin/tubulin and chaperone-assisted assembly/stabilization, lacking the prefoldin and post-chaperonin tubulin steps or ER/aggrephagy refolding of the confusables.

name: RUNX1, AP-2 and HOX transcription factor programs
rationale: All members are target-gene programs of RUNX, TFAP2 and HOX cluster transcription factors; the HOX and AP-2 members distinguish it from the haematopoietic RUNX1/megakaryocyte and granulopoiesis confusables.

name: Vasculogenesis and arteriovenous endothelial cell differentiation
rationale: Members concern de novo vessel formation, endothelial differentiation and arterial/venous vessel morphogenesis, unlike confusables centred on cardiac/coronary, BMP-driven or lymphatic development.

qualifier: type 2 mast cell and eosinophil immunity
name: Interleukin JAK-STAT signaling and type 2 mast cell-eosinophil immunity
rationale: Members span interleukin/interferon receptor signalling plus Th2, Fc-epsilon, mast cell, eosinophil and IgE responses; the type 2 effector members distinguish it from IL-17/wound or T-cell confusables, and the broad IL-2/IL-6-family signalling from the Th2-only confusable.

name: Gastrulation mesoderm formation and early cardiogenesis
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, EMT and mesoderm migration at gastrulation plus secondary heart field and heart morphogenesis, distinguishing it from endoderm/lateral plate and later heart tube confusables.

name: Fructose 2,6-bisphosphate glycolytic control and lactate fermentation
rationale: Members share glycolytic flux to lactate regulated by fructose 2,6-bisphosphate, which the hexokinase, pentose-phosphate and glycogen/glucagon confusables lack.

name: Melanin pigmentation and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis
rationale: Members concern melanosome/pigment granule formation and melanin synthesis together with related dense granule and coated vesicle cargo loading, distinguishing it from lysosomal enzyme targeting, organelle acidification and UV/melanocyte confusables.

name: Golgi disassembly-reassembly and RHOBTB/Ral GTPase cycles
rationale: Members combine Golgi ribbon disassembly/reassembly and positioning with atypical RHO (RHOBTB), Ral and GTPase activity regulation, whereas confusables centre on ARF/RAB vesicle budding and membrane tubulation.

name: Reproductive tract, gonad, mammary and pancreas development
rationale: Members cover sex determination, gonad/genital tract, prostate, mammary and pancreatic lineage development, distinguishing it from lung, kidney and salivary branching-morphogenesis confusables.

name: Platelet VWF-GPIb adhesion, activation and degranulation
rationale: Members concern platelet adhesion through VWF-GPIb-IX-V and collagen, degranulation and aggregation, distinguishing it from confusables built on ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and GPVI receptor signalling.

name: Solute carrier transport of carboxylates, carnitine and glucose
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of di/tricarboxylates, carnitine, glucose and sialic acid incl. the malate-aspartate shuttle, unlike confusables centred on amino acid transport or TCA/pyruvate/glutamate metabolism.

name: Exogenous peptide presentation via MHC II and cross-presentation
rationale: Members share peptide antigen processing via MHC class II and class I cross-presentation pathways, distinguishing it from lipid/CD1 and TLR7 confusables and from classical MHC I peptide loading.

name: Regulation of axon collateral sprouting and regeneration
rationale: All members regulate collateral sprouting or neuron projection regeneration, distinguishing it from Sema3A/ephrin repulsion, axon guidance and injured-axon regeneration confusables.

name: Hydrogen peroxide metabolism and nitrosative stress responses
rationale: Members concern H2O2 production, catabolism and cellular responses plus nitric oxide/reactive nitrogen responses, distinguishing it from ROS detoxification, BACH1, ferroptosis and oxidative apoptosis confusables.

name: GPI anchoring, Hedgehog lipidation and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members combine GPI anchor synthesis/attachment, Hedgehog palmitoylation/autoprocessing and glycosphingolipid synthesis, distinguishing it from RAS processing, depalmitoylation and glycolipid transport confusables.

name: Inner ear development and auditory-vestibular hair cell function
rationale: All members concern ear morphogenesis, hair cell specification/stereocilia and hearing and balance sensation, distinguishing it from eye, cranial nerve and microvillus confusables.

qualifier: maternal mRNA clearance and piRNA silencing
name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and piRNA transposon silencing
rationale: Members cover oocyte construction, maternal mRNA decay, zygotic genome activation, zygotic epigenetic programming/imprinting and piRNA silencing, distinguishing it from spermatogenesis/germline and general mRNA decay confusables.

name: Vascular remodeling, wound healing and endothelial activation
rationale: Members concern vessel remodeling, vascular wound healing, endothelial activation/proliferation/apoptosis and smooth muscle adaptation, unlike confusables centred on leukocyte adhesion, VSMC phenotype/shear stress or VEGF angiogenesis.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism
name: PPARA, LXR and SREBP control of lipid-glucose metabolism
rationale: Members are nuclear receptor/SREBP/PGC-1alpha programs regulating triglyceride, fatty acid and gluconeogenic metabolism, distinguishing it from adipocyte differentiation and circadian nuclear receptor confusables.

name: Adenylate cyclase-cAMP-PKA signaling to CREB
rationale: All members concern adenylate cyclase-generated cAMP activating PKA and CREB, distinguishing it from CaMK-CREB, PDE/DARPP-32 and MECP2 confusables.

name: Glial fate specification and oligodendrocyte lineage proliferation
rationale: Members regulate glial fate, astrocyte/oligodendrocyte differentiation and glial/OPC proliferation, distinguishing it from midbrain neuron/Bergmann glia confusables and from myelin formation/maintenance confusables.
